# Reference workbench provenance

The top-level annotations were reviewed in the existing primary maintenance
context under proofcheck 1.4 and renewed on 7 September 2026 after rereading the
unchanged source and each atomic inference. The existing balanced canary responses
were retained from the earlier primary review; they are smoke-test
qualification, not a blinded performance result. The current calibration
receipt is linked in each annotation file.

The actual independent challenge responses and their exact consumed packets
are preserved inside the portable audit under audit/05_adversarial/initial-*.json.
The fixed records include earlier findings, genuine contract-3 responses with
both judgment dimensions, and superseded review history. The theorem's earlier
argument-status disagreement is explicitly resolved without editing its first response.
The primary review and reconciliation are explained in
proofcheck-audit/audit/07_runtime/PRIMARY_REFRESH_1_4.md and
proofcheck-audit/audit/07_runtime/PRIMARY_RENEWAL_2026_09_07.md.

Earlier annotation and canary-response bytes remain in history/protocol-1.3.
The annotations preceding the earlier renewal remain in history/pre-renewal-2026-09-07.
The source-and-reader repair annotations follow an actual new primary review;
their predecessors remain in history/pre-usability-repairs-2026-09-07.
The current independent responses agree on both invalid arguments and refuted
statements, while retaining the previous theorem disagreement in history.
Do not silently bind those historical judgments to a new source or calibration.

The final unreadable auxiliary-context regression repair required another
actual primary reconfirmation and recompilation under the current validator.
Those predecessor annotations are preserved in
`history/pre-context-recovery-2026-09-07`. The source and judgments are unchanged;
the new source-bound primary review is recorded in
`proofcheck-audit/audit/07_runtime/PRIMARY_CONTEXT_RECOVERY_2026_09_07.md`.
A separate fresh packet-only reviewer supplied the new current initial
responses. Prior disagreements and reconciliation evidence remain linked.
